user_statement: 超声波测距模块，圆柱型元件的直径为 16mm，两个圆柱总宽为 42mm，离面板高度为 10.3mm
derivation_assumptions: Two equal-diameter cylinders are side by side, with parallel axes and aligned centers along the measured width.
42 mm is the outer-edge to outer-edge span; center spacing = 42 - 16; gap = 42 - 2 * 16.
notes: 10.3 mm preserves the user wording: height from panel; the panel datum is not identified as PCB or robot fascia.
Cylinder dimensions do not establish the complete module envelope or confirm the retail variant.
cad_scope: Two cylinders only; robot front-panel outer face Y=-81 is a provisional datum; PCB and rear components omitted.
